title: 5 Steps on How to not loose at a hackathon?
why_read: A lighthearted opinion piece on hackathon strategy and mindset, offering soft advice rather than technical content.
analysis: This article offers general life and social advice for approaching hackathons, written by a community manager, focused on networking and mindset rather than code or engineering techniques. It's a pleasant, anecdotal read but has essentially no technical substance for an engineering audience. Its value is motivational/community-oriented rather than instructive from a technical standpoint.
